title: Slot claims without a timestamp bypass the claim-horizon bound (policy decision needed)
description: Edge finding (j6o2 round): the new EXPIRY_TOO_FAR horizon check (slot_claim.py verify_slot_claim) is skipped when claim.timestamp is None (to_cbor_map omits it) — a legitimately-signing gateway can escape the 5-superframe pre-booking bound by omitting the field. This is documented in-code but is a spec-level policy decision, not enforcement: either (a) require timestamp on slot claims (wire/validation change — from_cbor and GCP-6.2 docs), or (b) accept the gap and note that global/per-originator caps (worker-7's 07pj, pending sync) remain the real bound. Decide with Mark or at the spec level; do not silently close. Ref beads: j6o2, 70p7, 07pj.
